definition.simple: Data kept aside and not used to build or tune a rule, then used once to test it.
definition.balanced: Out-of-sample results are usually weaker than [[in-sample]] ones, because tuning picks up some noise. Once you change a rule because of out-of-sample results, that data has become in-sample and you need fresh data.

example: Tune on candles 1–400, then test the finished rules once on candles 401–600.
